item.title: [supply-chain] UNC1069 Social Engineering of Axios Maintainer Led to npm Supply Chain Attack
item.description: The&nbsp;maintainer of the Axios npm package has confirmed that the supply chain compromise was the result of a highly-targeted social engineering campaign orchestrated by North Korean threat actors tracked&nbsp;as UNC1069.
